search.queryText:
_sourceCategory = Labs/GCP/vpc logName resource timestamp
| json "message.data.resource.type" as type 
| parse regex "\"logName\":\"(?<log_name>[^\"]+)\"" 
| where type = "gce_subnetwork" | where log_name matches "projects/*/logs/compute.googleapis.com%2Fvpc_flows"
| json "message.data.jsonPayload.connection.src_ip", "message.data.jsonPayload.start_time", "message.data.jsonPayload.end_time" as src_ip, start_time, end_time

| concat(substring(start_time, 0, 23), "Z") as start_substr
| concat(substring(end_time, 0, 23), "Z") as end_substr
| toMillis(parseDate(start_substr, "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSS'Z'")) as start_millis
| toMillis(parseDate(end_substr, "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSS'Z'")) as end_millis
| end_millis - start_millis as duration

| count by src_ip, start_time, end_time, duration
| sort by duration desc
| fields -_count
